elements.name: spriteloop.play_anim
elements.description: Plays an animation on a SpriteLoop component.

parameters.name: animation_id
parameters.doc: Animation id or name to play. Exact ids are matched before names.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional table with loop and emit_events booleans. emit_events controls the full playback session and defaults to true.

returnvalues.name: played
returnvalues.doc: True when the animation id or name exists and playback started.

elements.name: spriteloop.stop_anim
elements.description: Stops playback on a SpriteLoop component.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_time
elements.description: Sets playback time in seconds.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional table with emit_events. Destination-frame events emit by default.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_frame
elements.description: Sets the current frame index.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional table with emit_events. Destination-frame events emit by default.

elements.name: spriteloop.consume_events
elements.description: Returns and clears SpriteLoop animation events collected since the previous call.

returnvalues.name: events
returnvalues.doc: Array of event tables with event_name, name, data, animation_id, animation_name, frame, and source_frame.

elements.name: spriteloop.listen
elements.description: Registers a Lua callback for a SpriteLoop animation event on one component.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function called with the event table when dispatch_events consumes a matching event.

returnvalues.name: listener_id
returnvalues.doc: Numeric listener id that can be passed to unlisten.

elements.name: spriteloop.unlisten
elements.description: Removes SpriteLoop event listeners for one component.

parameters.name: listener_or_event_name
parameters.doc: Optional listener id or event name. Omit to remove all listeners for the component.

returnvalues.name: removed
returnvalues.doc: True when one or more listener entries existed.

elements.name: spriteloop.dispatch_events
elements.description: Consumes queued events and calls matching Lua listeners registered with listen.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_playback_rate
elements.description: Sets playback rate multiplier.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_visible
elements.description: Sets SpriteLoop component visibility.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_tint
elements.description: Sets a whole-character runtime RGB tint multiplier.

elements.name: spriteloop.clear_tint
elements.description: Resets the whole-character runtime RGB tint multiplier to white.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_skin
elements.description: Sets the active runtime skin.

parameters.name: skin_id
parameters.doc: Skin id or name. Exact ids are matched before names.

returnvalues.name: changed
returnvalues.doc: True when the skin id or name exists.

elements.name: spriteloop.set_variant
elements.description: Overrides one part variant. Pass "default" to clear the part's manual variant override.

parameters.name: part_id
parameters.doc: Part id, key, or name. Exact ids are matched before keys and names.

parameters.name: variant_id
parameters.doc: Variant id, key, or name for the selected part. Exact ids are matched before keys and names. If a real variant matches "default", it is selected instead of clearing the override.

returnvalues.name: changed
returnvalues.doc: True when the part and variant resolve to a matching pair, or when "default" successfully clears the override.

elements.name: spriteloop.clear_variant
elements.description: Clears one part variant override.

parameters.name: part_id
parameters.doc: Part id, key, or name. Exact ids are matched before keys and names.

returnvalues.name: changed
returnvalues.doc: True when the part id or name exists.

elements.name: spriteloop.clear_variants
elements.description: Clears all part variant overrides.

elements.name: spriteloop.get_part_transform
elements.description: Returns the current resolved component-local transform of an image or Empty Part.

parameters.name: part_id
parameters.doc: Part id, key, or name. Exact ids are matched before keys and names.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional origin setting. Use origin "pivot" (default) or "center" for the transformed base-image center.

returnvalues.name: transform
returnvalues.doc: Table with position, rotation, scale, skew, and opacity, or nil when the part is unavailable.

elements.name: spriteloop.debug_destroy_component
elements.description: Debug helper that releases one SpriteLoop component runtime instance.

returnvalues.name: destroyed
returnvalues.doc: True when a live component instance was destroyed.

elements.name: spriteloop.get_info
elements.description: Gets debug playback and package information.

returnvalues.name: info
returnvalues.doc: Package and playback information, including pending_event_count, max_pending_events, and dropped_event_count.

elements.name: spriteloop.get_cache_info
elements.description: Gets shared package and texture cache diagnostics.

returnvalues.name: info
returnvalues.doc: Cache entries, reference counts, texture counts, and approximate texture bytes.
